svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 8.92k stars in total, about 1.23k a year earlier. mr boxington 597, aube 2047, fnox 2311, hk 1281, pitchfork 694, usage 1062, +6 more 927.
